sentence: Japanese farewells hide a similar gap between literal pieces and everyday translation: [sayonara](/sayonara-meaning/) is glossed as a simple "goodbye," but its literal sense is closer to "if that\'s how it is." It can sound final in some settings, but is also used for ordinary classroom departures.
